title: MAMHOI: Factorizing Scene-Aware Human-Object Interaction through Affordances
abstract: arXiv:2610.12416v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generating realistic human-object interactions (HOI) in complex 3D scenes requires two complementary capabilities: reasoning about interaction feasibility in the environment and synthesizing realistic human-object motion. However, supervision for these capabilities is rarely available jointly at scale. Human-scene datasets provide rich information about environment-aware motion, while human-object datasets capture detailed interaction dynamics, yet paired human-object-scene data remain scarce. We present MAMHOI, an affordance-mediated factorization for scene-aware human-object interaction generation. MAMHOI factorizes scene-aware HOI generation through an explicit motion-affordance interface between scene understanding and motion synthesis: a scene-conditioned model first predicts where and how an interaction can be feasibly executed, and an affordance-conditioned HOI model then generates the corresponding human-object motion. translated_title: MAMHOI：通过可供性分解场景感知的人-物体交互
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.12416v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：在复杂3D场景中生成真实的人-物体交互（HOI）需要两种互补的能力：对环境中交互可行性的推理，以及合成真实的人-物体运动。然而，这两种能力的监督数据很少能够大规模地同时获得。人-场景数据集提供了丰富的环境感知运动信息，而人-物体数据集捕捉了详细的交互动力学，但成对的人-物体-场景数据仍然稀缺。我们提出了MAMHOI，一种以可供性为中介的场景感知人-物体交互生成的分解方法。MAMHOI通过在场景理解与运动合成之间建立显式的运动-可供性接口来分解场景感知的HOI生成：一个以场景为条件的模型首先预测交互可以在哪里以及如何可行地执行，然后一个以可供性为条件的HOI模型生成相应的人-物体运动。这种分解……
tldr: 该论文提出MAMHOI框架，通过显式的运动-可供性接口将场景感知的人-物体交互生成分解为场景条件下的交互可行性预测和可供性条件下的运动合成两个阶段，从而缓解成对的人-物体-场景数据稀缺的问题。
en_tdlr: MAMHOI factorizes scene-aware human-object interaction generation into a scene-conditioned affordance prediction stage and an affordance-conditioned motion synthesis stage, addressing the scarcity of paired human-object-scene data.
